subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally freeze the renamed and flattened question/session-catalog protocol shapes for the next beta and planned public `@openclaw/gateway-protocol` publication?
rationale: The branch makes a deliberate compatibility tradeoff based on a claimed shipped-surface audit; source-level correctness cannot establish whether maintainers accept the remaining beta/external-client upgrade impact.

options.title: Accept the cleanup window
options.body: Confirm that affected beta and prospective external clients may migrate to the new protocol shapes, then require the requested live proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve a temporary compatibility surface
options.body: Keep or document a bounded migration contract for the renamed/flattened fields before publishing the package.

options.title: Split publication policy from refactoring
options.body: Land only non-breaking cleanup and defer externally visible protocol reshapes until a dedicated API-freeze decision.

recommendation.title: Accept the cleanup window
recommendation.body: Confirm that affected beta and prospective external clients may migrate to the new protocol shapes, then require the requested live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned current change owner authored the protocol audit and implementation series; final acceptance should be recorded by the responsible maintainer.
